top.author: @CoderDaMing
top.text: 13. Custom Filters Stop manually deleting promotional spam emails. How to use: Check the box next to the annoying email, click the three dots > "Filter emails like this." Set it to automatically skip the inbox, add a "Read Later" label, or delete it before you see it.
top.translationZh: 13. 自定义过滤器 别再手动删除垃圾推广邮件了。使用方法：勾选烦人邮件旁边的框，点击三个点 > "过滤类似邮件"。设置自动跳过收件箱，添加"稍后阅读"标签，或者直接删除不让你看到。

top.author: @rashfordeyo
top.text: 5. Find your first paying user before you think about scaling. Reach out to 20 businesses by cold email. Show them your demo, offer a free trial, and ask for honest feedback. Iterate fast based on what they hate or love.
top.translationZh: 5. 先找到第一个付费用户，再考虑扩张。冷邮件联系20家企业，给他们演示产品，提供免费试用，要诚实反馈。根据他们喜欢什么讨厌什么快速迭代。
